name: On-Demand Services
description: On-demand helper bookings: skill- and availability-matched helpers with travel buffers, preferred-helper scheduling, recurring visits, pre-shift checks with replacements proposed for controller approval, and GPS ETA alerts.
description_zh: 按需上门服务预约：按技能与空档匹配帮手并预留车程，指定帮手排期，定期上门，班前确认与待主管批准的替换建议，以及 GPS 预计到达提醒。
